templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from dataflow-dag by the note-writer: a plain five-box left-to-right pipeline; the 'Serverless Graph' is a named artifact passed between boxes but never actually drawn as nodes and edges anywhere in the figure.
templates.what_to_learn: The transferable move is pipeline's: run coloured dashed bands along the bottom naming which paper section documents each stage, and group the plugin-style services (S3, SQS, Pub/Sub) as small icons inside one stage rather than drawing each as a separate box.
